title: Mod for AL-TeamChat
description: The Mod for the TeamChat Plugin, for a better overlay
body:
The optional client-side companion for the TeamChat plugin — displays your team chat in a clean, customizable overlay on the side of your screen.

⚠️ Requires the TeamChat plugin on the server. Without it, this mod has nothing to display. Players still need the **teamchat.use** permission to see the team chat.

You find the TeamChat plugin [here](https://modrinth.com/plugin/al-teamchat)

✨ Features

- Custom chat overlay — shows the team chat in a sleek panel instead of mixing it into the regular chat
- Fully customizable — adjust position, size, colors, and transparency to fit your style
- Lightweight & clean — built with Fabric, no clutter
- Seamless — works automatically once connected to a server running the TeamChat plugin

⚙️ Configuration

You can open the settings in two ways:
  - Command: /tcmod config
  - Mod Menu: open the mod's settings directly through [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)


📦 Requirements

- Fabric Loader + Fabric API
- The TeamChat plugin running on the server 
- Minecraft 1.21.x
- (Recommended) Mod Menu for easy in-game configuration


🔑 Note

This mod only displays team chat data that the server sends to players who have permission. It cannot show messages you're not allowed to see — access is controlled entirely by the server.


If you find bugs or have suggestions, you can find our Discord here:
